title: Dig Survivors
description:
DIG SURVIVORSDig deeper. Get stronger. Survive the horde.

Dig Survivors is a mining-focused action roguelite where the battlefield is yours to destroy. Carve your own path through the underground, uncover valuable ores, build an arsenal of powerful weapons, and survive increasingly overwhelming hordes of creatures lurking beneath the surface.

Every run sends you deeper into a dangerous, destructible world where deciding where to dig can be just as important as deciding how to fight.

DIG YOUR OWN PATHThere is no predetermined route through the underground.

Break through walls, tunnel toward valuable resources, open new paths through the cavern, and use the environment to escape—or funnel—the swarms chasing you.

But digging takes time, and the horde doesn't stop while you mine.

BUILD YOUR ARSENALDefeat enemies and gain experience to transform your miner into an underground killing machine.

Discover new weapons, upgrade the ones you already have, and combine powerful bonuses to create a different build every run.

Focus on overwhelming firepower, rapid attacks, massive area damage, mobility, or mining efficiency.

MINE VALUABLE ORESDig into the cavern walls to uncover rare ores hidden underground. Decide whether to risk venturing away from safety for another deposit or keep moving before you're surrounded.

Use what you collect to grow stronger and unlock new possibilities.

SURVIVE THE HORDEThe deeper you go, the worse it gets.

Enemy numbers grow. Stronger creatures emerge. Space becomes increasingly valuable.

Your weapons attack while you focus on movement, positioning, mining, and staying one step ahead of the swarm.

EXTRACT AND DESCENDSurvive long enough and extraction becomes available.

Fight your way to safety, spend the Gold you've collected, improve your build, and descend into the next stage with your weapons and upgrades intact.

Each descent brings greater danger—and greater rewards.

How deep can you dig before the underground finally claims you?

FEATURES• Destructible environments you can dig through freely

• Fast-paced bullet-heaven combat

• Large enemy hordes

• Weapons and upgrades that create unique builds each run

• Valuable ores hidden throughout the environment

• Gold-based between-stage upgrades

• Multiple increasingly dangerous stages

• Boss encounters

• Permanent progression and unlocks

• Pixel-art underground environments

• Solo and online co-op
description_short: Dig through a destructible underground world, uncover valuable ores, build an arsenal of powerful weapons, and survive relentless hordes of enemies. Extract, upgrade, and descend deeper in this mining-focused action roguelite.
